name: CT 臓器体積・体組成
description: Segment a CT series into 117 structures with TotalSegmentator (task total, Apache-2.0 weights) on an external GPU such as Google Colab, then measure organ volumes, CT values and muscle areas at the L3 level with GRAPHY-Next (H66).
